why: GW Explorer is a named, publicly released curriculum package of self-guided computational notebooks rather than a general instructional element.
name: GW Explorer: A Beginner's Guide
product_description: A three-notebook Python and Jupyter curriculum for introducing high-school and early-undergraduate learners to gravitational-wave astrophysics, computational literacy, waveform simulation, and simplified Bayesian inference, created by Rachel Langgin and collaborators.

why: This is a short, workshop-based instance of Mentoring and Coaching, although its evidence concerns a combined notebook-and-mentor intervention rather than mentoring alone.

rejected.verifier: The claim concerns coding-confidence changes across a notebook sequence and does not directly involve mentoring or coaching.

why: This is a setting-specific curriculum sequence for high-school and early-undergraduate gravitational-wave physics learners, not a general reusable pattern.
